This confirms my complete list. This matches exactly what I compiled — 35 production files call `isEnabled` directly, plus the test file which I'll exclude as it's not a real runtime "caller" asking on behalf of an actual user.

The predicate is `isEnabled(flag, ctx)` in `src/lib/feature-flags.ts`. It's the single function that evaluates a flag's rollout strategy against a `FlagContext` for "this caller." Files that only build a `FlagContext` (e.g. `buildFlagContext`/`orgFlagContext`/`flagContextFor` helpers alone), that hold/consume a precomputed `FeatureFlagSnapshot` (e.g. `feature-flag-provider.tsx`, the dashboard `layout.tsx`, `tenant-context.ts`), or that render a gate by delegating to `readFlag`/`useFeatureFlag` (`feature-gate.tsx`, `use-feature-flag.ts`) never call `isEnabled` themselves and are excluded. Several components/hooks first check a snapshot value and only call `isEnabled` as a live fallback (`top-bar.tsx`, `app-sidebar.tsx`, `kanban-board.tsx`, `command-groups.ts`, `use-command-palette.ts`, `config/nav.ts`) — these do call the predicate directly, so they're included.
